summary: MGE Energy filed an 8-K on May 6, 2026, regarding an underwritten public offering of 3,300,331 common shares via an underwriting agreement with Morgan Stanley, Guggenheim, BofA, and J.P. Morgan. Of these, 990,099 shares were sold directly by the company at $72.9094 per share, and 2,310,232 shares are covered by forward sale agreements with the same banks as forward purchasers, to be physically settled at the company's discretion by January 8, 2028. Proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes, including debt repayment and capital expenditures. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation—no acquisition, activist, restructuring, or regulatory trigger; thus it falls outside all defined categories.
